IMPORTANT NOTE

The V2.5.0 update removes GLOBALLY OPTIONAL functionality for components. The update contains new functionality that allows a component to be ADDED/REMOVED as OPTIONAL/EXLCUDE for all resource types.

To migrate existing GLOBALLY OPTIONAL components:

  • On the Configuration page, click the Edit button for the component you wish to migrate.
  • Expand the Globally Optional Configuration section.
  • Click ADD to add the component as OPTIONAL for all resource types.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • The Azure Naming Tool will moving to a new GitHub repo in the next version! This change will allow us more frequent updates, enhanced features, and the ability to request new features and report bugs.

    View the Azure Naming Tool V3 Migration Guide
  • You can learn more about the new Identity Provider Integration HERE.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • With the release of v4.0.0, the Azure Naming Tool will be upgraded to a .NET 8 Blazor Web App. This will require an update to the hosting environment, as well as a BACKUP & RESTORE of your configuration. Review the v4.0.0 Migration Guide for details.

    View the Azure Naming Tool v4.0.0 Migration Guide

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • With the release of v4.1.0, the Azure Naming Tool now supports uppercase and lowercase characters for resource names. Use the Configuration page to update the component options.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • With the release of v4.3.0, the Azure Naming Tool now supports Resource Type editing. Please see the Resource Type Editing documentation for guidance on metadata editing.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • With the release of v5.0.0, the Azure Naming Tool introduces a modern redesigned UI, SQLite database storage option, and Azure resource name validation. Please review the v5.0.0 Migration Guide for upgrade instructions and new features.
  • New features include: Modern UI with improved dashboard, SQLite database support for enhanced performance, Azure validation integration for real-time name conflict detection, and enhanced API capabilities. See the v5.0.0 Release Notes for full details.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Version 5.0.3 adds validation metadata for Azure subscriptions and management groups, including current length and character requirements.
  • The Resource Types catalog now includes 98 additional Azure resource types and corrected naming scopes, length limits, character rules, fixed-name values, and validation patterns based on the current Azure resource naming rules.
  • The Resource Locations catalog now includes Denmark East, India South Central, and China East 3 based on the current Azure public and sovereign cloud region lists.
  • Resource Type editing now keeps Optional and Excluded component selections and reliably displays its action buttons.
  • Global Optional and Excluded component updates now use a single safe SQLite replacement operation, including configurations that retain existing record IDs.
  • Resource Instance auto-increment now updates the configured instance component regardless of its position in the generated name.
  • The UI test project now targets .NET 10, and application dependencies include the latest security and maintenance updates included with this release.
